turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
One example first.
Word: "owl". Its first sound is "o", a vowel sound. So I say: I see an owl.
Rule: we use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: I see a dog. Wrong: I see an dog.

Now you. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
